title: Palak Paneer with Purslane
subtitle: baked with halloumi or tofu
description: A palak paneer-style curry using purslane in place of spinach, with halloumi (or tofu for a vegan version) in a spiced yoghurt sauce, finished in the oven.

steps.text: Blitz the purslane leaves (stems removed) and coriander in a food processor to a coarse puree. Set aside.
Heat a tablespoon of the coconut oil in a pan and fry the cubed halloumi (or tofu) for about 1 minute on each side until lightly golden. Transfer to a plate.

Heat the remaining coconut oil in the pan and fry the chopped onion for 1-2 minutes, stirring, until translucent. Add the cumin seeds and fry for about 1 minute. Add the chopped green chilli, garlic and grated ginger and fry for another minute. Add the turmeric and coriander seeds and fry for another minute.
Add the yoghurt (or coconut cream), season with salt and pepper, stir and bring to a gentle simmer. Lower the heat and cook for 3-4 minutes.
Transfer to a casserole dish, add the purslane puree and the halloumi or tofu cubes and mix well. Cover and bake for about 2 hours.
